messages:
ria: FYI onboarding quickpack for customer Caspian's LoRA (v0.6) found a small but repeatable number-format regression after our int4 build. Repro below.

henry: Can you paste the failing example and which quantizer/version?

ria: Repro case from their promptpack: 

```
input: "Payment due: $7,890,123.45"
expected: "$7,890,123.45"
int4-output: "7890123.45 dollars"
fp16-output: "$7,890,123.45"
```

jo: Which quant pipeline? Any tokenizer diffs?

ria: gptq-4bit (gptq-2025-04) on tokenizer v16. Quick token diff:

```
tokenized(fp16): ["Payment"," ","due",":"," ","$","7",",","890",",","123",".","45"]
tokenized(int4): ["Payment"," ","due",":"," ","$","7890123",".","45"]
```

henry: Looks like the BPE merge during quant conversion swallowed the commas. Two options: 1) short-term route invoice-like traffic to fp16; 2) add a packaging pre-split that inserts a ZW separator between digit and comma when building AWQ/GPTQ artifacts for this client.

jo: Also run an embed-sanity check. Rerank flips happened in another customer's onboarding when tokenization changed. Even if format is fixed, we should verify no downstream ranking drift.

ria: I ran a quickpack locally with a pre-split patch and the four failing prompts pass. Command used:

```
./ci/run_quickpack.sh --client caspian --adapter lora/caspian-v0.6 --base cascade-base-3b --quant gptq-4bit --patch pre_split_digit_comma --prompts tests/caspian_currency_small.jsonl
```

infra-bot: CI job queued: quickpack/4001239876-repro matrix=[fp16,gptq-4bit,awq-4bit] job=556677

eval-bot: quick-eval results uploaded: s3://redwood-test-results/caspian/4001239876/summary.json \u2014 4 failures before patch \u2014 see failing-cases.json :warning:

henry: Good catch. Please add these prompts to tests/caspian_currency_blockers.jsonl and tag them blocking. We'll gate the pre-split behind a feature flag scoped to client header x-client=caspian.

ria: Added tests and opened infra PR: infra/quant/patches#900 (title: gated: pre-split digit-comma for caspian).

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: canary/caspian-digitfix @ 2025-05-20T04:00:00Z \u2014 target pool: dedicated-canary-6 

jo: After canary, run embed-sanity and latency smoke. If token counts shift a lot it could affect batching. Monitor token_count histograms + p50/p95 latency.

infra-bot: canary started: job=556790 logs=https://deploys.redwood.dev/jobs/556790

eval-bot: post-patch quick-eval: 160/160 pass (currency regressions cleared) \u2014 artifacts: s3://redwood-test-results/caspian/4001239876/postpatch.json :tada:

henry: Nice. We'll keep the feature flag for two weeks and then consider promoting globally if no regressions crop up. Please add a note in the onboarding checklist for Caspian about quant-tokenization sensitivity.

ria: Will do. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
